about.paragraph_1: I’m a founder and builder from Kigali, Rwanda, passionate about turning barriers into opportunity through companies, communities and technology.

faq.question: What do you build?
faq.answer: I build software products, accredited educational foundations, and digital ecosystems. My primary ventures include Risevana Foundation (rural education & nutrition for 1,200+ children), Libblio (school library intelligence software), and Atomiq (digital design, branding, and software agency).

faq.question: How do you approach a project?
faq.answer: I believe in conviction, velocity, and practical utility. Whether writing software or constructing school classrooms, I start with direct community and user needs, build working prototypes rapidly, and iterate based on real feedback.

faq.question: Where are you based?
faq.answer: I am based in Kigali, Rwanda, but work with partners, founders, and institutions across East Africa, Central Africa, the Middle East, and Europe.

faq.question: What are you learning right now?
faq.answer: I am constantly deepening my mastery of full-stack software architecture, AI-augmented developer workflows, distributed systems, and sustainable nonprofit governance.

faq.question: Can we collaborate or hire Atomiq?
faq.answer: Yes. Atomiq collaborates with forward-thinking founders, tech companies, and community organizations looking to build world-class web applications, brands, and digital infrastructure.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: You can reach out directly via email at hello@axelkarambizi.com or phone at +250 788 749 709. Let us talk about your vision and how we can bring it to life.
